summary: Ingredients: • 1 lb ground chicken • 1 egg • ½ cup plain breadcrumbs • ½ cup grated zucchini • ¼ cup grated carrots • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F 2.
